sources.entry: o8 - Open-source desktop app that reviews coding agents' work, sends it back until it passes, and merges it. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/o8-run/o8)

summary.name: o8
summary.one_liner: o8 is a free, open-source desktop app that acts as a review and merge layer for coding agents: a separate agent reviews the real diff, sends findings back to the author, and merges the approved commit.
use_cases: Having a second agent review another coding agent's diff before merging
Reviewing AI-generated code changes in place
Sending agent review findings back to the author until checks pass
Keeping agent conversations linked to pull requests and code changes
Merging approved agent commits from a desktop workspace
summary.what_it_does: o8 is a desktop workspace for coding agents built around review and merge. A separate agent reviews the actual code diff, and its findings are sent back to the agent that wrote the change. Once the change passes review, the approved commit can be merged. The app brings agent conversations, files, changes, and repository activity into one place, and lets users open a change in place and see what changed and the checks at a glance. It works with the user's existing agent subscriptions and supported CLIs rather than providing its own model access. The page says it is MIT licensed and open to forking.
notable: A separate agent reviews the real diff and sends findings back to the author until it passes
Uses existing agent subscriptions and supported CLIs instead of bundled model access
MIT licensed and built to fork; source on GitHub (o8-run/o8)
caveats: Windows is not yet supported; the page says it is next
Requires the user's own agent subscriptions and supported CLIs
